findings.message: devolverComMotivo needs a typed reason (details.motivoDevolucao) but the definition has no devolverComMotivo.input state; added devolverComMotivoDraft with setDevolverComMotivoDraft. id and version are not typed: the method takes the id and reads the version from esperaPorMim.
The four commands return only resumo and esperaPorMim; avisoDoDia (its counts and tasks) is not in their output and may stay stale until carregarInicio runs again. Nothing was added.
public devolverComMotivoDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public setDevolverComMotivoDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
